capabilities: Keep the editor view centered on the cursor while typing
Adjust the typewriter offset toward the top or bottom of the page
Restrict scrolling to arrow keys and typing edits, not mouse selection
Dim non-active lines with an optional Zen Mode
disambiguation: Not a typewriter font, sound, or formatting tool; it only changes how the view scrolls to keep the cursor centered.
extras: Free and open-source with optional donations. README states the plugin is very experimental and some parts may not work; code was copied from another repository and modified.
problem: Obsidian's editor scrolls normally, so the cursor can drift toward the bottom of the view instead of staying at a fixed, centered position.
summary: Typewriter-scroll plugin that keeps the editor view centered on the active line while you type or move the cursor.
